summary: Recognize exact integrated commit trees before blocking work admission

delivery.outcome: Avoid false clone-local admission conflicts for unregistered branches whose complete unique commit trees already occur in target history; publish the bounded source fix without advancing the release version.
nonGoals: No branch deletion, terminal receipt inference or transfer of writer authority.
No effect-specific push exemption, target adoption or Taskand deployment.

architecture.decision: Keep the existing closed report and pure Git observer. Before an unassigned-branch conflict, require all unique commit trees to match target history. Preserve every ref and registered-writer check; cache only within the single immutable observation.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded admission change; original branches and their content remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Real Git fixtures with different commit IDs and identical complete trees.
Negative fixtures preserve all unique work, active scopes and WIP checks.
Closed report validation, no-write assertions and full hub delivery gate.
